name: dsh-profile-bina
description: The `bina` harness profile of עזריה: stock dsh-base + dsh-web-app, plus the office's own plugins (Hebrew language pack, brand, office context, timeline, cost meter …). עזריה's own screen — one list of Azaria's and Claude's conversations — is not a harness plugin: it is apps/bina-ds/web/, served by the adapter. Installed at image build; $DSH_HOME/profiles/bina points here at runtime. The harness is pinned EXACTLY (@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.2-rc.3, the newest release, 2026-11-13 — there is no non-prerelease), and `pnpm.overrides` pins the eight packages its tree still asks for by a `~` range (measured on rc.3: every dsh-* package names its siblings exactly; only cordis, its four plugins, cosmokit, node-addon-system and schemastery are ranged). A mixed set fails at import time (2026-09-17: dsh-app-boot 0.1.6-alpha.2 dropped an export the CLI imports), so nothing in this tree may drift. EXU-64.
